units.source_text: “要道谢的话，请向千重子小姐道谢好。”

en.t: If you want to thank someone, please thank Miss Chieko.

units.source_text: 秀男嘴上虽这么说，但是他为能给这位杉村姑娘织腰带，

en.t: Although Hideo said this aloud, the thought that he could weave an obi for this Sugimura girl

units.source_text: 心中充满了喜悦，感情激动不已。

en.t: filled his heart with joy and left him deeply moved.
